Description
At Bishop Montgomery High School, students have access to incredible resources, including elite, newly-built facilities - including STEAM facilities, with a Robotics Lab, Maker Space, World Language Lab, and two new computer labs. The school was named a Top STEM High School 2020 by NewsWeek Magazine and has an A+ overall Niche.com grade. The school also has a state-of-the-art Anatomage Table used for 3D anatomy visualization. Students can take part in an ACE (Architecture, Construction, Engineering) mentorship program with a local construction company, Project Lead the Way Engineering Program, and a Sports Medicine internship and pathway program. The school's famed basketball team has won over 40 championships in the past 50 years. Additionally, all Bishop Montgomery graduates satisfy all admission requirements for all public California universities and colleges.
